map.：y=x²-4x+3 的判别式 Δ=16-12=4>0，抛物线与 x 轴有两个交: The discriminant of y = x^2 - 4x + 3 is delta = 16 - 12 = 4 > 0, so the parabola crosses the x axis twice (x = 1 and x = 3); at delta = 0 it is tangent at one point, and at delta < 0 there is no crossing.
